LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Moths: {WHO} saw pale moths gather at a light at {HOME} in the night, more of them than anyone had seen before, and stay there.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_WaterRisen: {WHO} found the water standing higher in the wet ground at {HOME} at dawn, though no rain had fallen in the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_SunShaft: {WHO} saw a single shaft of sun come down through the gray sky at {HOME} and rest on one place a long while.
